classification: preregistered bounded QuartzCore capture_backdrop symbol-prefix and direct-call-target recovery; not a producer-mesh policy or unseen geometry transfer

openedDisassemblyFacts: The direct call at symbol offset 0x2b54 returns to the intercepted producer vertex-buffer path at 0x2b58.
The opened 2 KiB window starts only at symbol offset 0x2758 and therefore cannot expose the earlier crop/allocation branches.
The opened window constructs four 48-byte vertices from transformed binary32 bounds and subtracts integer origins immediately before the producer draw.
Repeated direct calls in the opened window target the same vertex-emission helper, but the complete helper and all preceding caller branches were not independently retained.
limitations: The existing call-site window is not a symbol prefix and starts after potentially relevant decisions.
The complete capture_backdrop symbol size is unavailable from dladdr, so a bounded 0x4000 prefix must not be described as a proven complete function body.
Disassembly structure alone does not identify live operand values or establish the producer crop/mesh law.
No unseen native geometry has tested a derived policy.

frozenQuestion.objective: Retain enough exact mapped QuartzCore code to reconstruct the crop/edge decision path that produces the sample-31 four-vertex mesh, without adding a fitted image or geometry hypothesis.
frozenQuestion.symbolRule: Resolve capture_backdrop from the intercepted VfxXgh/A2Xghfc producer stack and retain exactly 0x4000 mapped bytes beginning at dladdr's symbol address.
frozenQuestion.decisionRegionRule: Decode every arm64 direct BL instruction at four-byte alignment in the half-open symbol-offset range [0x2000,0x2b58). Preserve source instruction, ASLR-relative target metadata, and target bytes without filtering by a desired hypothesis.
frozenQuestion.targetRule: Every decoded direct-call target must resolve into the same mapped QuartzCore image and retain exactly 0x400 bytes beginning at the target. Any unresolved or partial target fails the code-evidence gate.
frozenQuestion.knownAnchorRule: The decoded direct-call set must contain the already opened producer vertex-binding call at symbol offset 0x2b54.
frozenQuestion.matrixRule: Repeat the unchanged 114-record sample-31 unit/repeat matrix. Capture-integrity, q, allocation/copy, live-state, and same-state evidence remain governed by the schema-4 matrix validator; code capture may not replace those gates.
frozenQuestion.nullOutcome: A missing symbol, missing 0x2b54 anchor, byte-count/hash mismatch, direct-call decode mismatch, target outside QuartzCore, or partial target capture fails closed and remains reported.

analysisPlan.controlFlow: Classify all direct, conditional, compare-and-branch, test-and-branch, indirect, and return instructions in the frozen decision region directly from captured words.
analysisPlan.directCallGrouping: Group calls only by validated target image offset and require identical symbol metadata and target-code SHA-256 for repeated targets.
analysisPlan.disassembly: Use the pinned LLVM development shell to disassemble the validated symbol prefix and target prefixes after opening; preserve instruction offsets and distinguish observed code from inferred semantics.
analysisPlan.policyRecovery: Map exact arithmetic and branch predicates to the already opened mesh transitions. Do not fit a universal law merely because the code path is visible.
analysisPlan.nextGate: Only a single exact candidate that explains every opened allocation/mesh record may be frozen for a distinct native-geometry holdout.

notClaimed: a proven complete capture_backdrop function body
live register or stack operands for the retained instructions
a recovered universal crop, allocation, or producer-mesh integerization law
an unseen native Apple geometry transfer
a profile, material, appearance, direction, endpoint, scale-factor, or Retina transfer
permission to modify or approximate the protected production shader
permission to trade image quality for memory, throughput, or latency
